findings.title: Default value `queued: datetime = timezone.now()` is evaluated once at import time
findings.body: In `AssignmentSource`, `queued: datetime = timezone.now()` is evaluated once when the module is imported rather than when each `AssignmentSource` instance is created. Every instance constructed without an explicit `queued` argument will share the exact timestamp of module import. Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` from `dataclasses` so `timezone.now()` is called per instance.

findings.title: Passing `assignment_source` to `installation.sync_assignee_outbound` breaks concrete implementations
findings.body: `sync_assignee_outbound` task now calls `installation.sync_assignee_outbound(external_issue, user, assign=assign, assignment_source=parsed_assignment_source)`. However, in `IssueSyncIntegration` (`src/sentry/integrations/mixins/issues.py`), `assignment_source` was added to `sync_status_outbound` (line 416) instead of `sync_assignee_outbound` (line 397), and concrete `IssueSyncIntegration` subclasses (e.g. Jira, Jira Server, GitHub, GitLab, VSTS) define `def sync_assignee_outbound(self, external_issue, user, assign=True, **kwargs)` or without `**kwargs` (only `ExampleIntegration` or classes accepting `**kwargs` tolerate extra keyword arguments). Any integration implementation of `sync_assignee_outbound` that does not accept `**kwargs` or `assignment_source` will raise `TypeError: sync_assignee_outbound() got an unexpected keyword argument 'assignment_source'` when syncing outbound to a different integration than the source.
